articles.title: Robinhood's new crypto network is printing cash, and it's sending Arbitrum's token soaring
articles.snippet: Revenue on Robinhood Chain hit a 24-hour record of $1.9 million, driving a 30% rally in ARB as traders chased downstream gains.

articles.title: Sony Argues in Court That Digital Games Can't Be Owned
articles.snippet: The PlayStation maker is fighting a California class action over "Buy Now" buttons, and has asked the judge to send the case to arbitration.
